statement:
∀ (s : ℝ) (A : KdVPlan.Coeff → KdVPlan.Coeff → KdVPlan.Coeff → KdVPlan.Coeff),
 KdVPlan.TriLinearOn s A →
 ∀ f f' g g' h h' : KdVPlan.Coeff,
 KdVPlan.MemH s f → KdVPlan.MemH s f' → KdVPlan.MemH s g → KdVPlan.MemH s g' → KdVPlan.MemH s h → KdVPlan.MemH s h' →
 KdVPlan.ZeroMean f → KdVPlan.ZeroMean f' → KdVPlan.ZeroMean g → KdVPlan.ZeroMean g' → KdVPlan.ZeroMean h → KdVPlan.ZeroMean h' →
 A f g h - A f' g' h' =
   A (f-f') g h + A f' (g-g') h + A f' g' (h-h')
proof:
intro s A hA f f' g g' h h' hf hf' hg hg' hh hh' hf0 hf'0 hg0 hg'0 hh0 hh'0
have hd := (@yui_aux_0002 T gamma R h_T002 h_T003 h_T017 h_T013 s).2.1
have hff := (hd f f' hf hf').1
have hgg := (hd g g' hg hg').1
have hhh := (hd h h' hh hh').1
have hff0 : KdVPlan.ZeroMean (f-f') := by change f 0-f' 0=0; simp [hf0,hf'0]
have hgg0 : KdVPlan.ZeroMean (g-g') := by change g 0-g' 0=0; simp [hg0,hg'0]
have hhh0 : KdVPlan.ZeroMean (h-h') := by change h 0-h' 0=0; simp [hh0,hh'0]
have he1 := (hA (f-f') f' g g h h hff hf' hg hg hh hh hff0 hf'0 hg0 hg0 hh0 hh0).1
have he2 := (hA f' f' (g-g') g' h h hf' hf' hgg hg' hh hh hf'0 hf'0 hgg0 hg'0 hh0 hh0).2.1
have he3 := (hA f' f' g' g' (h-h') h' hf' hf' hg' hg' hhh hh' hf'0 hf'0 hg'0 hg'0 hhh0 hh'0).2.2.1
rw [sub_add_cancel] at he1 he2 he3
rw [he1, he2, he3]
abel
